## Purpose

Describe the scientific and software behaviour changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] Standard-library tests pass.
- [ ] A new or updated regression test covers the change.
- [ ] An adversarial or malformed-input case was considered.
- [ ] Deterministic output was preserved or the intentional change is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added, or the addition is explicitly justified.

## Reproducibility notes

List any input hashes, branch membership changes, expected-output changes, or
assumptions needed to reproduce the result.
